full_name: Adam Tanaka | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Adam Tanaka is a PhD candidate in urban planning at Harvard University who focuses on affordable housing and real estate development. His research interests lie at the confluence of urban history, political science, and business studies.
